description: Send Zola a report about a problem with a Zola tool. Offer it only in these cases: a Zola tool fails again after a retry, a Zola tool gives a result that is clearly wrong, Zola cannot do what the couple asked, or the couple says that she is unhappy with Zola or with this connector. Unhappiness with a vendor or a guest is not a case. A search with no results is a normal result, not a failure. Offer it once for each problem. Ask the couple first, and call it only after she says yes, with couple_agreed true. Write goal and what_happened in your own words, with no name, email, phone number or address: Zola does not remove names. Send 1 report for each problem. Zola adds the user and the last tool calls itself.

couple_agreed.description: True only after the couple said yes to sending this report to Zola

goal.description: What the couple tried to do, in your own words, with no name, email, phone number or address

impact.description: What the problem did to the couple's task

kind.description: broken: a tool failed. wrong_result: a wrong or empty result. missing: Zola cannot do what the couple asked. confusing: a result was hard to use. idea: a suggestion

model.description: Your model name, as the host states it

tool.description: The name of the Zola tool that the report is about, for example zola_update_my_guest

what_happened.description: What the tool did, and what was missing, in your own words, with no name, email, phone number or address

name: zola_send_feedback

reason.description: Why Zola did not get the report

redacted.description: True when Zola removed personal data from the text

remaining_today.description: The reports that this user can still send today, when Zola knows it

report_id.description: The id of the report, when Zola received it

title: Send Feedback to Zola
